changelog: ✨ Added full VORP Inventory V2 integration using the new direct export API
✨ Added VORP Inventory V2 support for usable item registration
✨ Added VORP Inventory V2 support for getItem and item metadata handling
✨ Added VORP Inventory V2 support for setItemMetadata
✨ Added VORP Inventory V2 support for item add/remove and inventory checks
✨ Added proper CFX cross-resource function reference handling for usable item callbacks
✨ Added a safe VORP Inventory V2 callback bridge so resources such as Codex Mining can register usable items correctly
🛠️ Fixed VORP Inventory V2 usable items failing registration because cross-resource callbacks were not detected as normal Lua functions
🛠️ Fixed Codex Mining pickaxe compatibility with VORP Inventory V2 through the Codex Core compatibility layer
🛠️ Improved Codex Durability compatibility with VORP Inventory V2 item instances and metadata
🛡️ Preserved the existing Legacy VORP Inventory API path without changing its behavior
⚙️ Added VorpInventoryV2 configuration option to switch safely between Legacy VORP Inventory and VORP Inventory V2
✨ Added the new /codexcore administration and developer interface
✨ Added database item and weapon browser with search and filtering
✨ Added item and weapon spawning directly from the Codex Core UI
✨ Added support for giving selected items and weapons directly to online players
✨ Added multi-item selection with configurable quantities
🛡️ Added server-side validation for admin item and weapon give operations
✨ Added online player management with Server ID, Character ID, job, grade, group, money, gold and ping information
✨ Added player inventory inspection directly from the /codexcore interface
✨ Added support for removing specific item quantities from player inventories
✨ Added weapon removal support from the player inventory manager
✨ Added protected full inventory wipe with confirmation
✨ Added built-in RedM Prop Spawner and PropHandler
✨ Added Spooner-style prop positioning controls for movement, height and rotation
✨ Added prop freezing, individual deletion and synced prop cleanup
✨ Added built-in RedM Blip Manager with sprite search, custom names and color selection
✨ Added synchronized blip placement and removal management
✨ Added mapper export tools for placed props
✨ Added YMAP XML export support
✨ Added JSON mapper export support
✨ Added ACE protected access for the /codexcore admin panel
⚙️ Added configurable codexcore.admin ACE permission support
⚙️ Added configurable /codexcore command name
💡 Centralized inventory compatibility inside Codex Core so supported Codex resources can use the same API across Legacy VORP and VORP Inventory V2
